title: Brass Eye Episode 07 - Paedogeddon! (Special)
summary: The Brass Eye special 'Paedogeddon!' by Chris Morris, a black-comedy satire of British media moral panic that duped celebrities and politicians into endorsing nonsense. It is the final episode of the series.
why: HN cites it as the classic satire of moral panics, especially when child-safety or illegal-image legislation is discussed.

quote.text: You may enjoy Chris Morris in this Brass Eye special
